output.headline: Ironvale's direct passing sequence ends in a giveaway
output.text: Ironvale strung together four completed passes, including a 33.4 distance ball from Callum Reid to Luca Romero, but the chain ended when Romero's pass to Hiro Tanaka went out. Momentum sits at 26 with chaos at 45 in a 0-0 game.
